notes.title: Let's continue the conversation on Discord!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44007847/d1f1ab016a0f8901742407f3d850e914f3ecdc94.png[/img]

Hello there, I'm the Maveus manager. 

Are you enjoying your time playing Maveus? We value your feedback and are constantly listening to players' opinions through various channels. Although there is still a long way to go, we strive to make the game better through regular updates. We sincerely appreciate the interest you've shown.

Discord is the fastest channel for the Maveus team to respond. It's also a great platform to engage with other players and Mave fans, sharing feedback about the game. We would be grateful if you could visit our Discord server.

Discord Link: https://discord.gg/s5gdUwAXtw

As a manager, 
I'm eager to hear directly from the players' voices.

Thank you.
